title: Fleet Control Lane: soft-scaling knobs, scheduled policies, and change ledger
creator: Asha Patel
description: Deliver a consolidated Fleet Control Lane in Console that exposes: 1) soft-scaling knobs (min/max/cushion) per fleet, 2) scheduled autoscale policies (time-of-day, weekday/weekend, holidays), 3) a throughput timeline with per-tenant percentiles and cost projection, and 4) an immutable change ledger that shows operator edits, automated policy drift, and rollback hints. The goal is to give operators predictable throughput guarantees while making scaling activity auditable and reversible.
acceptance_criteria: Operators can set per-fleet soft-cap parameters (min, target cushion, max) and see immediate estimated p50/p95 latency impact
Scheduled autoscale policies can be created with cron-like recurrence or simple weekday/time ranges and are shown in a calendar UI
Throughput dashboard shows 7/30-day histograms, per-tenant top contributors, and a cost delta if autoscale or cushion values change
Change ledger records all edits (user/automation), including old vs new values, timestamp, actor, and a single-click rollback suggestion when a recent edit correlates with latency regressions
Console UI passes accessibility QA and scales on mobile/tablet layouts
Server-side API endpoints are documented and gated behind feature flag fleet_control_lane and covered by unit/integration tests
notes: This ticket consolidates several smaller PM and ENG initiatives: scheduled autoscale (previously PM-27109), ledger UI fragments (previously PM-74211), and throughput projections. We will ship behind a feature flag and target a small alpha with two enterprise customers for end-to-end validation.
